answer: Identity renewal is a fourteen-day cure. The applicant seals a legally tagged ivory chip and a cultured pearl inside a fresh cedar capsule whose moisture curve is logged by a public kiln. Only after the capsule reaches a signed equilibrium moisture content does a lab open it and match both serials to the application; a second capsule in the same kiln, or a pearl transferred mid-cure, invalidates the batch and burns the posted stake. Because the cure cannot be rushed and serialized ivory and pearls are quota-limited, a sybil farm pays real time and real material per identity.
